citation.authors: Tishkoff SA, Reed FA, Ranciaro A, Voight BF et al

record.design: Genotype-phenotype association study with in vitro tests of the gene promoter
record.finding: Three SNPs (G/C-14010, T/G-13915 and C/G-13907) were associated with lactase persistence and raised transcription from the LCT promoter in vitro. They arose on different haplotype backgrounds from the European C/T-13910 variant and from each other. Haplotype homozygosity extended more than 2 Mb on chromosomes carrying C-14010, consistent with a selective sweep over about 7,000 years. The authors describe convergent evolution driven by animal domestication and adult milk consumption.
record.note: East African pastoralist and related populations; Black British or Caribbean people descend from many African groups, so the figures do not transfer.
